title: Blues
identity: Donemus public preview confirms Frédéric Devreese's Blues for alto saxophone and piano, composed 1989, catalog no. D14211, duration about four minutes. The preview identifies the alto saxophone as E-flat and provides a transposed score excerpt. This is the correct saxophone work; the title is Blues, rather than a separate presumed Sax Blues variant.

evidence.claim: Donemus score cover and information page identify Blues for alto saxophone and piano (1989), D14211, and approximate four-minute duration.

Notation preview inspected: saxophone part enters with sustained notes and triplet figures over repeated piano chords in 4/4 at Allegro moderato quarter=104; dynamics move from piano to forte in the viewed excerpt.

score_observations.observation: The inspected 4/4 excerpt begins Allegro moderato, quarter=104. The saxophone sustains notes and alternates with triplet figures over repeated piano chords; the excerpt moves from piano to forte. No range is stated.

review_focus: Inference: follow the sustained-to-triplet saxophone motion, dynamic growth, and repeated chordal piano part in the preview.
collection_flag: Original saxophone/piano work documented by the publisher, 1989.

gaps: Only one score page was inspected; the remainder of the four-minute work and any recording remain unverified.
